items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13; all volumes (40, 90, 200, 50, 45 µL) use the p300 within its 20–300 µL range, no well overfilled, labware loaded with the right labels, and all measured checks passed.

Every helper picks up a fresh tip per well and drops it, including reagent dispenses, so no tip is reused across samples. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all passed.

All 13 steps appear in order with the right quantities, the mixes happen 10 times, and the comments for incubation, magnet, drying and re-engage sit at the correct points. No extra steps change the outcome.
reagent_in(beads['A1'], 40, mix=40) puts 40 µL into each of the 96 wells with p300.mix(10, 40, w), followed by the 5 min incubation comment.
The magnet engage/wait comment comes first, then remove_to(90, waste) runs for every well. Two 200 µL ethanol additions each follow a full 200 µL removal to waste.
Comments record the 5 min air dry and the magnet disengage. Then 50 µL water goes into each well with a 10x mix, then the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage comment.
zip(wells, elut) moves 45 µL from each sample well to the matching elution plate well, one tip per well. The end_state:elution_plate check passed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows every step with correct volumes, fresh tips per well, and comments for all non-simulated steps. All measured checks passed, so every item scores 1.
